cases.title: PressureGrid core allocation and fail-closed behavior
cases.acceptance: Inventory/purity, direct/fallback allocation, lease staging/commit/expiry, interruption recovery, 64-provider latency, and overflow all match the documented invariants.

cases.title: Persistent config and banked-transaction interruption
cases.acceptance: Power loss/reflash exposes only old-complete or new-complete durable state and replay never double-applies a committed request.

cases.title: Shared commissioning input and diagnostics behavior
cases.acceptance: Fallback/removal, snapshot coherence, commit retention/console advance, and shared-panel ownership behave as documented.

cases.title: Sequencer physical state-machine behavior
cases.acceptance: FILL/SETTLE/DRAIN, repeat/complete, timeout, device loss, numeric fault, reflash, and config replacement all fail safe and recover correctly.

cases.title: PhasePressure live thermodynamic request behavior
cases.acceptance: Live phase boundaries, HOLD/EVAPORATE/CONDENSE requests, direct-write ownership, profile/device faults, and Host replacement match the documented contract.

cases.title: PressureDomain arbitration and actuator ownership
cases.acceptance: Multi-producer arbitration, medium/mode filtering, generation restart, clamping, standby, write ownership, and 64-provider latency are physically verified.

cases.title: Multi-hop pressure routing
cases.acceptance: Two/three-hop staging, bottleneck normalization, failed-hop invalidation, planner reflash, disjoint paths, and STORAGE-to-STORAGE restrictions hold in game.

cases.title: Cost-aware pressure route ranking
cases.acceptance: Hop/lift/flow weights and candidate budget select the expected route while downstream reservation safety remains authoritative.

cases.title: MaterialGrid and furnace physical execution
cases.acceptance: Vending slots/scans, exact Stacker batches, chute faults, topology changes, Arc Furnace transforms, output evidence, reflash, and timeout behavior match the modeled contracts.

cases.title: Generic Job Store live persistence and lifecycle
cases.acceptance: Capacity, atomic SET_STATE, stale-generation rejection, terminal immutability/reap, JobId reuse rules, coherent reads, and Gateway-only mutation are verified.

cases.title: Manufacturing scheduler live queue and execution behavior
cases.acceptance: Priority/fairness, WAIT progression, furnace condition rejection, printer capacity/replacement, reflash, and resource removal remain fail closed.

cases.title: Operator one-shot recipe-order ingress
cases.acceptance: One commit publishes one recipe-resolved PRINT root with quantity and priority intact; held commit, invalid recipes, and service reflashes cannot duplicate or create an unsatisfiable job.

cases.title: Stock-target demand and root-job ingress
cases.acceptance: Sufficient stock stays idle; an exact deficit publishes one root; duplicate targets share active output; lower-bound/stale views suppress publication; and evaluator, publisher, or Gateway reflash never duplicates the root.

cases.title: ITEM storage, LArRE, SDB and reservation movement
cases.acceptance: Slot semantics, reservation ownership/generation, LArRE pickup/recovery, destination obstruction, SDB lower-bound discovery, and exact feeder delivery are physically verified.

cases.title: Power dispatch, batteries, transformers and break-before-make
cases.acceptance: Aggregate supply, managed demand, battery one-tick capacity, reserve/target policy, transformer overhead, load shedding, allocator reflash, and final authority fences are verified on real electrical networks.

cases.title: Cross-domain furnace atmosphere preparation
cases.acceptance: Items 1-7: ProcessCondition P/T demand, chamber routing, embedded pumps, composition/thermal preparation, and independent Transform Admission are verified end to end.

cases.title: Fuel-backed POWER generation
cases.acceptance: Items 8-9: GFG atmosphere/fuel/error shutdown behavior and measured watts versus live fuel moles/temperature/mixture are recorded without inventing a watt-to-pressure conversion.

cases.title: Cross-domain authority mutation and reflash
cases.acceptance: Items 10-11: reflashes and generation changes converge physical utilities to safe state before current authority is reacquired.

cases.title: Time-separated electrolyzer fuel storage cycle
cases.acceptance: If implemented later, surplus-power charging and GFG discharge cannot recursively enable one another in the same planning epoch.

cases.title: Console circuitboard mirror sinks render IC-written values
cases.acceptance: A Logic Memory tagged DiagAuto is enrolled by Console Registry v1.1, Renderer writes its Setting, and Consoles running Hash Display and Graph Display circuitboards linked to that Memory render the value. Renderer skips Mode/Color on the mirror without fault.

cases.title: Hash Display circuitboard Mode is settable from IC
cases.acceptance: Confirm the circuitboard slot index and that the Mode slot logic type is readable with ls and writable with ss. Hash Console Mode then switches a board between HashType.Prefab and HashType.GasLiquid, reports writes in S9, and counts unreadable records in S10 rather than faulting.
